# ArmSoft SME Trade Public API Docs

## Canonical Docs
- README: ./README.md
- Docs index: ./docs/index.md
- API reference: ./docs/api/README.md
- Products API: ./docs/api/products/README.md
- OpenAPI spec: ./openapi.yaml

## Authentication
- Header: `apiKey`
- Optional locale header: `Accept-Language` (`hy-AM`, `en-US`, `ru-RU`)

## Endpoints (v1)
- POST /api/v1/directories/products/list
- GET /api/v1/directories/products/{code}
- POST /api/v1/directories/products
- PUT /api/v1/directories/products/{code}
- DELETE /api/v1/directories/products/{code}
- POST /api/v1/directories/products/measureunits/list
- GET /api/v1/directories/products/{productCode}/measureunits/{unitCode}
- POST /api/v1/directories/products/measureunits
- PUT /api/v1/directories/products/{productCode}/measureunits/{unitCode}
- DELETE /api/v1/directories/products/{productCode}/measureunits/{unitCode}
